files.CONTRACT.md:
render_legend(series) returns the chart legend's HTML. Each series is a dict with name, color and visible.
The legend is a list with the accessible name Legend (data-testid legend). It holds one list item (data-testid legend-entry) per series whose visible is true, in input order. An entry's text is its series name, and it holds a colour swatch (data-testid legend-swatch) in the series colour. A series whose visible is false has no entry.
Roles, accessible names, entry text and data-testid values are the contract. CSS classes, wrapper elements and the hint below the list are styling and may change.

files.CONTRACT.md:
render_email_field(value) returns the HTML of the email field.
An invalid address gets an error message with role alert and id email-error, and the input carries aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby="email-error". A valid address gets no alert, and the input carries aria-invalid="false" and no aria-describedby.
Roles, ARIA attributes, ids and the message text are the contract. CSS classes and wrapper elements are styling and may change.

files.CONTRACT.md:
render_results(scores) returns the HTML of the results table. scores is a list of (name, points) pairs in any order.
With at least one pair, a table with the accessible name Results has a header row (Name, Points) and one data row per pair, ordered by points from high to low; equal points are ordered by name. With no pairs there is no table, and a status message reads No results.
The markup has no test ids. Table, row and status roles, the accessible name and the cell text are the contract; CSS classes and wrapper elements may change. results.py belongs to another team and is not changed in this task.
